children.doc: Fifteen or more open: the desk is swamped.
Groups quiet, busy, swamped; reacts to ticket.new, ticket.resolved, ticket.escalated

root.doc: A support desk's dispatcher: every ticket that arrives gets a ticket machine of its own (spawned through the pool processor); tickets report back with #_scxml_ sends, and escalated tickets wait for the dispatcher's approval. Synthetic, for the tracer's scale test.

datamodel.doc: tickets with a machine working on them

dispatcher.purpose: A support desk's dispatcher: every ticket that arrives gets a ticket machine of its own (spawned through the pool processor); tickets report back with #_scxml_ sends, and escalated tickets wait for the dispatcher's approval. Synthetic, for the tracer's scale test.
dispatcher.name: dispatcher

children.doc: Reading the ticket and deciding what it needs.
Asked the customer something; their answer comes later.
An agent works on it; some need an answer from the customer first.

root.doc: One support ticket, from triage to resolution: an agent works on it, some need the supervisor's approval first, some wait for the customer. It reports to the dispatcher and ends. Synthetic.

ticket.purpose: One support ticket, from triage to resolution: an agent works on it, some need the supervisor's approval first, some wait for the customer. It reports to the dispatcher and ends. Synthetic.
ticket.name: ticket

events.text: The desk opens. Tickets arrive about twice a second; each gets a machine of its own.
Midway: the desk is at its busiest.
No more tickets: the desk works through what is open.

stories.question: What happens when customers writing in sends ticket.new to dispatcher?
stories.answer: 28 events across 3 participants (customers writing in, dispatcher, T-001 (refund)) over 11.0 s.

steps.text: customers writing in sends ticket.new to dispatcher
dispatcher handles ticket.new, moves to busy, sends spawn to the ticket pool (spawns ticket machines)
T-001 (refund) starts, moves to triage, sends triaged to T-001 (refund) (+2)
dispatcher handles ticket.escalated, sends approve to dispatcher, handles approve (+1)
T-001 (refund) moves to investigating, sends worked to T-001 (refund), moves to resolved (+2)
dispatcher handles ticket.resolved
